name: print-social-black-we-are-hiring-poster-with-red-type-and-asterisks
title: Black 'We Are Hiring' poster with bold red type, outline italic 'New Member' and asterisk bullets
whatItIs: A portrait black poster with huge red 'WE ARE *HIRING' with an orange outline ring motif and blue asterisk, outlined italic 'NEW MEMBER' with an arrow, two orange role pills with descriptions, asterisk-bulleted work terms (Full time, In-house, Hybrid) and a red 'APPLY NOW!' with a yellow deadline tape.
whatItMeans: Loud and urgent; big red type and tape make the call to apply unmissable.
techniques: Mix solid and outline italic headline styles.
Stick a tilted tape strip over the CTA for the deadline.

vocabulary.definition: A tilted strip like sticky tape carrying text.
Slanted letters drawn only as strokes.
